properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-28, in the same breath as the step-back idea (dec:idea-a-step-back-review-sorts-the-open-list-into-overtaken-closable-and-pressing). Nothing here is settled.

HIS WORDS: "let's refocus on the most pressing things (and what are their neighbors - sometimes I feel that we are working so hard on satisfying a small thread, that we miss the big picture - maybe using the graph to see "neighborhoods" where we can focus on a whole region of the graph would be a good idea)."

THE IDEA: choose the unit of work as a REGION (a pressing item and its neighbours), so a session closes out one area of the design instead of pulling a single thread, and the surrounding picture stays in view.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS (searched before writing, 2026-09-28):
- design_regions (verified) lists the parts the design itself names, each with its size, open gaps, open defects and who claims it, ordered by how much is open. detect_gaps, detect_defects and claim_region then take that part as their scope. So "focus on a region" is available as a practice today.
- what_next's shaping band is the existing big-picture read: the few settled decisions most of the live design hangs off.
- topic_report gathers everything about one subject across node types, which is a neighbourhood by words rather than by edges.
What is missing: design_regions counts gaps and defects per region, not open DECISIONS or proposed requirements, and those are most of the "still to decide" pile. And what_next ranks single decisions, never regions.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
A. PRACTICE ONLY. The step-back (or where-am-i) reads design_regions, picks the region with the most pressing open items, and scopes the rest of the session to it. Cheapest: no build.
B. REGIONS COUNT WHAT IS UNDECIDED. design_regions also counts open decisions and proposed requirements per region, and what_next can rank a region as well as a decision. Medium: the region is already computed, and this adds two tallies and a ranking.
C. INFERRED NEIGHBOURHOODS. Clusters found from the edges (community detection) rather than the parts the design names. Most expensive, and it would REOPEN a recorded choice: design_regions was built on the design's own carve-up, "never an inferred one", because a cluster is reflow2 telling a reader what the parts of their design are on the strength of a heuristic. Taking this road is Anthony's call to reopen, not a live option on equal footing with the others.
D. A REGION BY TOPIC. Use topic_report's text neighbourhood as the region. Cheap, and it reaches ideas no Component contains. The cost is that shared words are a weaker tie than an edge.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, recorded beside the idea rather than used against it:
1. NEIGHBOURHOODS NEED EDGES, AND OPEN QUESTIONS HAVE FEW. dec:idea-do-ideas-form-a-graph-or-only-a-list measured 145 ideas with 12 edges between any two of them (2026-08-21). An edge neighbourhood of the "still to decide" pile would then be mostly singletons, so a region view may serve built structure well and serve poorly exactly the backlog it is meant to tame. The linking discipline added since may have changed that; not re-measured here.
2. MOST OF A MATURE DESIGN LIES IN NO REGION. design_regions reports this about itself: bookkeeping and many ideas sit under no Component. A region-first focus can leave those permanently out of view, which is the opposite of seeing the big picture.
3. A REGION CAN BE A THREAD WITH A BIGGER NAME. Scoping to one part still hides the rest of the design. The big-picture read is the shaping band and the step-back itself; a wider scope does not provide it.
properties.name: OPEN — should the unit of focus be a region of the design (a pressing item and its neighbours) rather than one thread, so the big picture stays in view?
properties.rationale: Captured on Anthony's instruction to record the ideas as ideas, at proposed, in his words, with counter-arguments beside them and nothing promoted. Split from the step-back idea because the two can be answered independently. The inferred-cluster option is marked as reopening a recorded choice rather than offered as live, per the brainstorm skill's rule that an option contradicting accepted intent is the owner's to reopen.
